Real use cases

Short-form generative video Text-to-video and image-to-video clips for social and marketing.
B-roll and effects AI-assisted editing tools for existing footage.
Rapid concept previsualization Test visual ideas for film/video before a full production.

Bottom line

Runway packs the widest range of video tools into one place, and the team ships new capabilities fast — sometimes faster than the documentation keeps up. Free credits disappear quickly once you start iterating, so budget for a paid plan if you're doing more than the occasional test clip.

Frequently asked questions

Is Runway free to use?

There's a limited free tier with credits; most regular use requires a paid plan starting around $15/mo.

What can Runway generate?

Text-to-video, image-to-video, and a range of AI-assisted video editing tools.

Is Runway good for beginners?

It has more of a learning curve than image tools, but tutorials and community content help.

Can I use Runway videos commercially?

Yes on paid plans — check current terms for specifics.

How fast do free credits run out?

Quickly — most testers exhaust the free allotment within a handful of generations.

When was Runway last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-05-28.
